title: A week with Mr R Science

scenes.note: Your face shows. Smile, look at the camera, relaxed and warm.
lines: Hi, I'm Mr Robert. This is a week with Mr R Science: what my pupils do after a lesson, and why.

scenes.note: Voice over the app's Check screen.
lines: Every lesson starts with a few quick questions on earlier work. No notes, no hints. Just: did it stick?

scenes.note: Voice over the coursebook page and the lab on the class TV.
lines: In class, I teach from the coursebook. The live lab runs on the TV, and pupils write in their own book.

scenes.note: Voice over the salt bridge lesson. Slow down on 'predict'.
lines: That evening, they watch one short lesson in my voice. It stops and asks them to predict, so they have to think before I explain.

scenes.note: Voice over the Build a cell lab.
lines: Then they train. Fresh numbers every time, and a hint only opens after a real attempt.

scenes.note: Voice over the coursebook page, then the answer book page.
lines: Then it's back to paper: the matching exercise in pen, marked from the answer book.
At the end of the week, three fresh questions with the help switched off. Then the weekly task that I mark.

scenes.note: Voice over the Return later screen.
lines: And a few days later, it comes back. Three quick questions, to check it really stuck.

scenes.note: Your face shows. Count the four words on your fingers if it helps, then smile.
lines: Watch, train, write, check. About half an hour after each lesson. It's free, there's no sign-in, and it works on any phone.

roomTone.note: Sit still and say nothing for 10 seconds. I use this to take out the background hum.
